mentions.name: DeFi Risk Management Infrastructure
mentions.description: This project aims to build risk management infrastructure for decentralized finance, applying traditional finance risk management expertise to put DeFi on a sound footing. It is currently in the research phase, with the builder pursuing a Master's in Computer Science to address CS skill gaps.
mentions.problem: Decentralized finance lacks sound risk management infrastructure.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently researching how I transfer my risk management skills from traditional finance into decentralized finance. I'd like to put decentralized finance on a sound footing by building risk management infrastructure for it.
